text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's independent midweek newspapers, The Sun and The Gazette, on Wednesday.

- A consortium of local companies, led by Universal Investments (Pty) Ltd and the Global Mining and Development Bank Botswana (Pty) Ltd are planning a multi-billion project to extract oil from coal in Botswana.
- The report of the auditor general for the year ended March 31 1995, says the value of reported losses by the government departments during that year declined by 43 percent.
- The leader of the Students' Representative Council at the University of Botswana (UB) has claimed police harassed him last week.

- Botswana is asking South Africa to lift visa restrictions on Batswana which allow them to remain in South Africa for only 30 days. The department of foreign affairs says this is having an adverse affect on students and migrant workers.
